description_en: Retrieves the enabled proof of concept (POC) feature trials
description_zh: 查询已开启的POC功能试用详情
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-poc-functions --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePocFunctions

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html获取当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

Functions.description_en: A list of the POC feature details

items.description_en: The details of the POC feature

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the POC feature trial. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
ExpireTime.description_zh: 实例的到期时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

Type.description_en:
The type of the POC feature trial. Valid values:

apisec: API security.

botWeb: bot management for websites.

botApp: bot management for apps.

largeLanguageModel: AI-powered application protection
